bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
service=gace-userbot-verify.service
unit=$(systemctl --user is-active "$service" 2>/dev/null || true)
test "$unit" = active || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$service" 2>/dev/null)" = enabled || exit 72
test "$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null)" = yes || exit 73
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" || exit 74
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 75
grep -Fq 'serve_resident' "$root/scripts/userbot_keepalive.py" || exit 76
sock="$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
test -S "$sock" || exit 77
test "$(stat -c %a "$sock")" = 600 || exit 78
test "$(stat -c %u "$sock")" = "$(id -u)" || exit 79
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_ALLOWLISTED_IPC=PASS
